theme.title: Playoff drama
theme.subtitle: 2002 to 2005
theme.recap: Boston shot its way past Philadelphia and erased a big deficit against New Jersey, and Robert Horry stole a Finals game in Detroit.

questions.prompt: In the deciding Game 5 of the 2002 first round against Philadelphia, Paul Pierce scored how many points?

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Paul Pierce led the way with 46, on 8-10 shooting from downtown

funFacts.text: Boston had reached the playoffs for the first time in seven years before meeting Philadelphia.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: This series marked the return of the Celtics to the playoffs for the first time in seven years

funFacts.text: The 76ers came into the matchup as defending Eastern Conference champions behind Allen Iverson.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: they faced the reigning Eastern Conference champion in the first round

funFacts.text: Antoine Walker shared the scoring burden during the series and helped Boston turn back Philadelphia's rally.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Antoine Walker stepped up for the Celtics

questions.prompt: Boston erased a big deficit in Game 3 of the 2002 East finals. How many points did it score in the fourth quarter?
questions.context: 2002 East finals · Game 3 · vs New Jersey

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: the Celtics outscored the Nets 41–16 in the fourth quarter

funFacts.text: Boston's historic Nets comeback began after the Celtics fell far behind in Game 3 of the East finals.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: In Game 3, the Celtics were down by as much as 26 points

funFacts.text: Kerry Kittles paced New Jersey's offense in the game Boston dramatically stole.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Pts: Kerry Kittles 19

funFacts.text: Paul Pierce was Boston's leading scorer in its playoff comeback against New Jersey.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Pts: Paul Pierce 28

questions.prompt: Boston made a playoff-record nine threes in one fourth quarter against Philadelphia in 2002. How many did it make in the whole game?
questions.note: 19, nine of them in the fourth quarter.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: hitting an NBA playoff record nine of them in the 4th quarter and 19 in the game

funFacts.text: Boston's barrage came in a winner-take-all first-round game against Allen Iverson's Philadelphia 76ers.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: This set the stage for a Game 5 in Boston to decide the series

funFacts.text: The Celtics' perimeter onslaught ended the Sixers' season and set up a series against Detroit.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Boston won in a huge blowout, sending them to the conference semifinals to face second-seed Detroit

funFacts.text: The hot shooting was concentrated in the fourth quarter, when Boston's perimeter attack caught fire.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: hitting an NBA playoff record nine of them in the 4th quarter

questions.prompt: Robert Horry hit the game-winner in Game 5 of the 2005 Finals. How many points did he score off the bench?

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Horry went 5 for 6 from beyond the arc, including the game-winner, and scored 21 points coming off the bench.

funFacts.text: Rasheed Wallace left Horry open when he doubled Manu Ginóbili, setting up the decisive shot.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Rasheed Wallace had left Horry to double-team Ginobili

funFacts.text: Horry did not score until the very end of the third quarter before taking over late.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: He hadn't scored a point until the final play of the 3rd quarter

funFacts.text: The shot added to Horry's reputation for late-game heroics, already established with the Lakers.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Horry was already famous for nailing last-second shots in the playoffs

questions.prompt: Detroit set a Finals record for the fewest turnovers in a game in 2005. How many did it commit?

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Collectively, the Spurs shot 37% and committed 17 turnovers to the Pistons' NBA Finals-record four.

funFacts.text: Detroit used its bench to devastating effect, with Lindsey Hunter and Antonio McDyess producing efficient minutes.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: especially efficient bench performances by Lindsey Hunter and Antonio McDyess

funFacts.text: The Pistons' defense limited almost every Spurs shooter to poor efficiency in the pivotal home game.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: only Tony Parker (6–13, 46.2% shooting) managed to surpass the 45% mark

funFacts.text: San Antonio and Detroit had been the NBA's premier defensive teams throughout the preceding seasons.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: the two premier defensive teams of that era
